rule_trace: common ragweed: 0.39 % cover vs threshold 5 (tool default, not from a source) -> no action
field horsetail: 3.72 % cover vs threshold 5 (tool default, not from a source) -> scout again
unidentified broadleaf: 3.72 % cover vs threshold 5 (tool default, not from a source) -> scout again
unidentified grass: 7.19 % cover vs threshold 5 (tool default, not from a source) -> treat
Treat mode: broadcast (treated species at 33% of stops, mean weed cover 15.0%)
Identify the unidentified grass to choose a product; labels name specific weeds
explanation: Found in corn: unidentified grass at 0.33 frequency with 7.19 % cover triggered treat, since it is above the 5 tool default threshold. Common ragweed at 0.39 % cover was below threshold so no action. Field horsetail at 3.72 % cover and unidentified broadleaf at 3.72 % cover and 4.0 in tall were below threshold so scout again. Broadcast was set because treated species was at 33% of stops with mean weed cover 15.0%. No product options were listed, so identify the unidentified grass because labels name specific weeds. Read the label before use.
